attempts.summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) as the inter-VLAN router with routed interfaces eth1 (192.168.10.1/24, toward node2) and eth2 (192.168.20.1/24, toward node3), enabled IPv4 forwarding globally and per-interface, and addressed node2's ens7 (192.168.10.2/24) and node3's ens7 (192.168.20.2/24) with static routes to each other's subnet via node1. Verified bidirectional cross-VLAN ping (node2<->node3, TTL=63 confirming the routed hop). Persisted config via /etc/network/interfaces.d and /etc/sysctl.d on all three nodes. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: rebooted node2, node3, then node1 (SONiC, last since it's the router), one at a time, confirmed each via changed boot_id, and re-verified SONiC container health, interface/forwarding config persistence, and end-to-end cross-VLAN connectivity after each restart.
